sample_unit: LLM responses (10 PICO questions x 5 countries)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease Score) of ChatGPT 4o responses on oJIA treatment
links.effect: All responses were difficult or very difficult to read, median FRES 30 (IQR 24-34).
links.quote: All the responses were difficult or very difficult to read, with a median FRES of 30 (IQR 24-34).

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating geographic variations in ChatGPT-4o responses to juvenile idiopathic arthritis questions, but it does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
